site.title: Teaching pages for the cardiac rotation.
site.lead: Start with the intro to the CT month, then work through Jim Goodman's cardiothoracic modules: bypass, circulatory arrest, ECMO, transplant and aortic surgery.

pages.title: Intro to the CT Rotation
pages.blurb: How the month works, how to set up, and how a bypass case flows from pre-op to the CTICU, with a printable one-pager.

pages.title: 1. Running cardiopulmonary bypass
pages.blurb: The circuit, heparin and protamine, physiology on pump, the run from heparin to separation, and crisis management.

pages.title: 2. Neuroprotection during circulatory arrest
pages.blurb: Hypothermia, antegrade and retrograde cerebral perfusion, monitoring, and drug adjuncts for arch surgery.

pages.title: 3. ECMO configurations: VV, VA & V-AV
pages.blurb: Central and peripheral cannulation, the mixing zone and differential hypoxia, TEE-guided cannulation, and troubleshooting.

pages.title: 4. ECMO-assisted lung transplantation
pages.blurb: Sequential bilateral transplant without CPB: PA clamp test, VA ECMO, controlled reperfusion, and PGD.

pages.title: 5. Heart transplantation
pages.blurb: Bicaval implantation step by step, the denervated heart, PVR and the donor RV, PGD grading, and RV failure.

pages.title: 6. Aortic surgery: root to descending
pages.blurb: AVR, Wheat, Bentall, David, hemiarch, total arch, FET, open DTA and TEVAR, plus spinal cord protection.
